name: isolated-pending-reply-room
script: window.__pendingReturnRoute=location.hash;return fetch('/api/v1/rooms/',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},signal:AbortSignal.timeout(15000),body:JSON.stringify({title:'Win7 pending avatar regression',creator_id:'user-admin',member_ids:['user-win7'],is_direct:true,task_session:true,client_request_id:crypto.randomUUID(),locale:'zh'})}).then(async r=>{const room=await r.json();if(!r.ok)throw Error('room HTTP '+r.status);window.__pendingRoom=room.id;location.hash='#/dms/'+room.id;return {room:room.id}})

name: pending-avatar-native-evidence
script: const row=document.querySelector('[data-work-lease-id]');const avatar=row?.querySelector('.avatar');const card=row?.querySelector('.message-card');const dot=row?.querySelector('.message-avatar-status');if(!row||!avatar||!card||!dot||document.querySelector('.composer > .composer-working'))throw Error('pending reply remained above composer');const a=avatar.getBoundingClientRect(),c=card.getBoundingClientRect(),d=dot.getBoundingClientRect();if(a.left>=c.left||d.right>a.right+1||d.bottom>a.bottom+1)throw Error('avatar layout invalid');return {pendingAvatarRows:document.querySelectorAll('[data-work-lease-id]').length,oldComposerFallback:false,avatarLeft:true,dotAnchored:true,hasStructuredProgress:!!row.querySelector('[data-turn-id]'),phase:row.innerText}
